## A map of equilibrium concepts
 
The diagram below shows how common equilibrium concepts relate to one another.
 
```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    A[Equilibrium Concepts] --> B[Nash Equilibrium]
    A --> C[Bayesian Nash Equilibrium]
    A --> D[Subgame Perfect Equilibrium]
    A --> E[Refinements]
    A --> F[Broader Notions]
 
    D --> D1[Sequential Rationality]
 
    E --> E1[Trembling-hand Perfect]
    E --> E2[Proper Equilibrium]
    E --> E3[Sequential Equilibrium]
 
    F --> F1[Correlated Equilibrium]
    F --> F2[Rationalizability]
```

## From basic equilibrium to refinements
 
```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A[Nash Equilibrium] --> B[Dynamic Consistency Concerns]
    B --> C[Subgame Perfect Equilibrium]
    C --> D[Off-path Belief Concerns]
    D --> E[Sequential Equilibrium]
    C --> F[Robustness to Mistakes]
    F --> G[Trembling-hand Perfect]
    G --> H[Proper Equilibrium]
```
